notes: Receive Funds (unit trust Register tab): record new funds or a top-up in one step. Each deposit is recorded on the product on its own date, the units go on the register as one allotment or top-up on a separate register date with its certificate, and a confirmation email draft (initial purchase or top-up wording, editable per trust, with Bcc) is prepared with the certificate attached. Records Consistency Check: investments paying to the same bank account under a different bank name, account name or BSB formatting can now be made the same.
